name: Nisha Raviprasad

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nisha Raviprasad is a poet from Kochi, Kerala, whose writing includes English haiku. Her work appears in the Summer 2021 issue of Wales Haiku Journal. Triveni Haikai India also features one of her haiku in its English-language selection, identifying her with Cochin and recording its publication in Mainichi Japan.

In her Kabita Live poem ‘Yesterdays’, memory gathers around scent, water, flowers and the moon. The poem revisits those images as it moves from disappointment towards a quieter present: drooping daisies bloom again, and the moon becomes an image of resilience. Its change of mood grows from looking anew at familiar things.
